name: Application Entry and API Layer
description: Exposes the Flask dashboard and command-line entry points for patient explanation and SMPL mesh export workflows.

name: Digital Twin Service Layer
description: Implements Stage 3 simulation, Stage 4 explain-only graph assembly, and patient-specific SMPL twin generation.

name: Data and Machine Learning Layer
description: Defines the shared BRFSS schema and model helpers and runs reproducible training, evaluation, SHAP, and scenario research pipelines.

name: Browser UI Layer
description: Renders the Jinja dashboard and supplies responsive styling and interactive Cytoscape behavior for Stages 1-4.

name: Validation and Test Layer
description: Verifies Stage 4 graph completeness, patient-data boundaries, model evidence fidelity, idempotence, and Neo4j fallback behavior.

name: Infrastructure and Configuration
description: Packages and orchestrates Flask, Jupyter, Neo4j, and SMPL workflows while defining dependencies, local settings, privacy exclusions, and supervisor handoff automation.

name: Research and User Documentation
description: Documents setup, operation, SMPL assets, research framing, validation evidence, limitations, and safe project handoff.
